preregistration.expected_outcome:
Does not outperform. On the development seeds at "auto" the composite's flag F1 was lower
on point (-0.20) and clustered (-0.16), higher on masking and irrelevant_columns, and it
breached the false-positive budget on every scenario (wrong flags 1.5-2.8x the review
budget; 2.1-3.1x the budget flagged in all). Its "auto" threshold sits far above the
review budget, while intersection@1 at "auto" stays within it.
preregistration.hypothesis:
composite-agreement@1's advantage (round 2) was measured with both policies at the review
budget. This tests whether it holds at the shipped scoring.contamination = "auto", where
each detector's own boundary sets the flags and the composite thresholds at the median
of the detectors' natural flag rates: flag F1 on point, clustered, masking and
irrelevant_columns, judged against the same budgets v3.
